policy: One new full run per arm because original exact resume state is missing after verified infrastructure interruption; not performance rescue. Original5000step recipe/seed/optimizer/source sampler/frontend/finalonly selection unchanged. Original interrupted outputs retained byte-for-byte. Separate recovered output/report names. Atomic overwritten recovery checkpoint every500: model,optimizer,torch/CUDA and sampler RNGs,progress/sourcehashes. Checkpoints for infrastructure recovery only, never recognition/selection. No neural numerical-equality gate, new source or heldout consumption. Record /proc/self/io every100steps. Execution wrapper uses bound original runner and applies only explicit logging/output/checkpoint hooks.
